name: qa_keyrowdlg
title: OS-KEYROWDLG, the F-key row under a dialog or a question: rows QA-FIL-099..101, QA-CFG-034, QA-GLB-118, QA-GLB-119, QA-PAT-276 of docs/qa/catalogue. Reads the `keys=` of the state line and keeps soft shots of the row for a person to look at; answers no question, accepts no dialog, applies no setting, writes nothing.

steps.say: OS-KEYROWDLG (docs/specs/OS-KEYROWDLG.md): the F-key row says what the keys do while a dialog or a question is up. Rows QA-FIL-099..101, QA-CFG-034, QA-GLB-118, QA-GLB-119, QA-PAT-276, QA-INS-214 and QA-WAV-009 of docs/qa/catalogue. The `state` line carries ` keys=` while a prompt is live (F3:ALL,F1:KEEP_INS: the live keys of the row in view, a space as _), so each step reads the keys as the app says them; the soft shots of the row are for you to look at (a soft pixel compare cannot prove a label). It writes nothing: no question is answered, no dialog accepted, no setting applied. The boot disk (QA-GLB-120) and INPUT TEST (QA-GLB-121) are by hand: the boot chords.

steps.note: (Shift released, in case a former run left it down)
(a leftover Navigator or keyboard is closed: F7 is CLOSE / CANCEL)
(a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is Back)
(a notification of the last scenario runs out, so the question is the line on the strip)

QA-FIL-101: OPEN RESCAN NEW .., none inverted

steps.say: QA-GLB-118: the keyboard. F5 SAVE AS opens it with the next free name; it is cancelled with F7, never accepted.

steps.say: Done. The boot disk (QA-GLB-120: eight RESTART, AGAIN? inverted while a computer writes, blank while it finishes) and INPUT TEST (QA-GLB-121: F2 F3 CLEAR, F4 F5 EXIT) are by hand: look at the two boot chords' screens.
